independence: Validator imports no optimizer, physics helper or shortest-path builder. Hand-authored exports are constructed without SCIP or production exporters; integration exports are a separate layer.
residual_boundaries: Inject 0.5 and 2 times each declared threshold. Family abs/relative tolerances come from execution contract section8; exact decoded logic uses zero tolerance. A passing row never excuses a separate failing family.

inactive_budget.expected: reject even though each dimensionless reciprocal error is below1e-8

mixed_budget.expected: reject aggregate; individual active and inactive totals are each below5e-8

scope: Feasibility within declared original-unit tolerances, not a proof of optimization optimality or a deadline/deployment policy. Later objective/deviation row families require explicit validator extensions.
